newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CBANK TO SIMPLIFY, EQUALISE BANKS LICENCING.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CBANK TO SIMPLIFY, EQUALISE BANKS LICENCING.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Friday said it would propose an amendment to the bank act simplifying licencing, putting branches of foreign banks on equal footing with their domestic counterparts.

"The board has discussed the (part) of the law...which cancels a two-grade permissioning proceedure (and) omits a requirement for an economic purposefulness assessment during the issuance of a (licence) to function as a bank," a statement issued after the board's regular meeting said.
"It equalises the position of Slovak and foreign entities during the issusance of (a licence) to establish a bank, or increase shares in the bank according to the law," the statement added.
It said the the law was in accordance with the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) requirements.
No further details were included in the statement.
